title: Audit existing Supabase/PostgreSQL schemas, migrations, tables, FKs, grants and RLS

steps.title: College Admin Authentication
steps.description: College Administrator opens documents desk as operational entry for schema-backed services

steps.title: Documents Desk Loaded
steps.description: Documents desk proves live UI path against audited doc schema

steps.title: Students RLS Forced
steps.description: Verify stu.students RLS enabled and FORCED
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'stu' AND c.relname = 'students' AND c.relrowsecurity = true AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true

steps.title: Guardianships RLS Forced
steps.description: Verify stu.guardianships RLS enabled and FORCED
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'stu' AND c.relname = 'guardianships' AND c.relrowsecurity = true AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true

steps.title: Lifecycle Status RLS Forced
steps.description: Verify stu.lifecycle_status RLS enabled and FORCED
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'stu' AND c.relname = 'lifecycle_status' AND c.relrowsecurity = true AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true

steps.title: Stage Requirements RLS Forced
steps.description: Verify doc.stage_document_requirements RLS enabled and FORCED
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'doc' AND c.relname = 'stage_document_requirements' AND c.relrowsecurity = true AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true

steps.title: Documents RLS Enabled
steps.description: Verify doc.documents has RLS enabled (FORCE gap documented in audit report)
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'doc' AND c.relname = 'documents' AND c.relrowsecurity = true

steps.title: Outbox Schema Present
steps.description: Verify sys.outbox_events table exists for intelligence outbox
steps.query: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'sys' AND table_name = 'outbox_events'
